US AVIATION CHAOS: OVER 22,000 FLIGHTS CANCELED OR DELAYED America’s air travel system is struggling to recover from its worst nationwide flight shutdown since 9/11. A nearly five-hour FAA ground stop on Friday triggered roughly 10,000 cancellations and 7,000 delays. Another 3,700 flights were canceled and 2,000 delayed Saturday, leaving tens of thousands of passengers stranded. The rocket descended belly-first, flipped upright and was captured by the tower’s giant mechanical arms instead of landing on the ground. SILVER COULD HIT $75 AN OUNCE IN 2027, BANK OF AMERICA SAYS Bank of America (BofA) says silver could climb to $75 an ounce next year as macroeconomic headwinds ease. Silver closed Friday at $48.74, down 6.1% for the week, pressured by a stronger dollar, higher oil prices and Fed rate-hike expectations. BofA forecasts: 🔸 2026: 910-tonne supply surplus 🔸 2027: 852-tonne supply deficit Analysts expect ETF flows and solar demand to remain the biggest drivers of silver prices.

SILICON VALLEY VS. WHITE HOUSE: BATTLE FOR NVIDIA Tech executives are pushing to reinstate Jensen Huang, while Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent reportedly opposes his return. A petition backing Huang has drawn 175,000 signatures. Yet prediction markets give Huang just an 18% chance of returning as CEO, behind Rene Haas at 21%.

Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO while the board searches for a successor.
